Definition: Bethuel, the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Bethuel = "God destroys" or "man of God" or "dweller in God"; n pr m; 1) nephew of Abraham, son of Nahor by Milcah, father of Rebekah; n pr loc; 2) a town of Simeon in the south
